2609.02275.title: Do Large Language Models Capture the Diversity in their Training Data?
2609.02275.paper_summary: Large language models are trained to model conditional distributions over text, yet it remains inadequately understood whether they capture the full diversity of plausible outputs present in their training data. We study this question through an information-theoretic lens by comparing the conditional entropy of model-generated outputs with that of the corresponding training data. Given paired input-output samples, we use conditional entropy and its matrix-based analogue based on von Neumann entropy to measure output variability beyond what is explained by the conditioning input, without requiring multiple reference outputs for the same prompt. Across LLM families with publicly available training data, including OLMo, Pythia, and GPT-Neo, we consistently find that model-generated outputs exhibit lower conditional entropy than their training data, across different model scales, sequence lengths, and decoding strategies. We observe a similar conditional diversity gap beyond language modeling, including class-conditioned ImageNet generators and text-conditioned models trained on MS-COCO. To address this gap, we propose a post-hoc correction mechanism that generates multiple outputs for each input and reweights them through a matrix-entropy projection, increasing conditional diversity while remaining close to the original model distribution. We prove the concavity of the matrix-based conditional entropy functional, which makes the resulting entropy-constrained projection a convex optimization problem, and develop a scalable mirror-descent algorithm for its implementation. Our results reveal a systematic conditional diversity gap between modern generative models and their training data, and provide an information-theoretic framework for measuring and mitigating this gap.
2609.02275.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型被訓練用來建模文本的條件分佈，但目前尚不清楚它們是否捕捉到訓練數據中存在的合理輸出全貌。<lb/>我們通過信息論的視角來研究這個問題，通過比較模型生成輸出的條件熵與相應訓練數據的條件熵。<lb/>給定成對的輸入-輸出樣本，我們使用條件熵及其基於冯·诺依曼熵的矩陣類比來測量超出條件輸入所解釋的輸出變異性，而不需要對於同一提示的多個參考輸出。<lb/>在包括OLMo、Pythia和GPT-Neo在內的具有公開可用訓練數據的LLM家族中，我們一致發現模型生成的輸出在不同模型規模、序列長度和解碼策略下，其條件熵均低於其訓練數據。<lb/>我們觀察到一個類似的條件多樣性差距，超出了語言建模的範疇，包括類別條件的ImageNet生成器和在MS-COCO上訓練的文本條件模型。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們提出了一種事後修正機制，為每個輸入生成多個輸出，並通過矩陣熵投影對其進行重加權，從而增加條件多樣性，同時保持接近原始模型分佈。<lb/>我們證明了基於矩陣的條件熵泛函的凹性，這使得結果的熵約束投影成為一個凸優化問題，並開發了一種可擴展的鏡像下降算法以實現其應用。<lb/>我們的結果揭示了現代生成模型與其訓練數據之間系統性的條件多樣性差距，並提供了一個信息論框架來測量和減輕這一差距。
